scenarios.setup: A race car on a circular and straight track.

tasks.prompt: Drive the car forward 50m. Predict the Distance and Displacement.
Drive the car in a complete circle back to the start. Predict the Displacement.
tasks.explanation: Displacement is a vector (shortest path from start to end). If you return to the start, your displacement is zero, even though you traveled a distance!

scenarios.setup: A cargo bay with a heavy crate on the floor and a floating crate in space.

tasks.prompt: Push the floating crate in space with a small force. What happens?
tasks.expectedOutcome: It moves at a constant speed forever.
tasks.explanation: In space (zero friction), an object in motion stays in motion. This is Newton's First Law (Inertia).

tasks.prompt: Roll the heavy ball into the light ball. Predict what happens after they collide.
tasks.expectedOutcome: Heavy ball slows down, light ball speeds up.
tasks.explanation: Momentum is conserved. The heavy ball transfers its momentum to the lighter ball.

scenarios.setup: Two tall tubes: one filled with air, one vacuum.

tasks.prompt: Drop a metal ball and a feather in the AIR tube. Predict which hits the ground first.
Drop the metal ball and feather in the VACUUM tube. Predict which hits the ground first.
tasks.expectedOutcome: They hit at the same time.
tasks.explanation: Gravity accelerates all objects at the same rate (9.8 m/s²). In a vacuum, there is no air resistance to slow down the feather!
